SDBC Saturday Ride

San Diego, CA · La Jolla / University City

Beginner friendly

SDBC Saturday Ride is a road group ride in San Diego, CA. It meets every Saturday, rolls 8:30 am; new-rider orientation 8:15 am, starting at UC Cyclery. Expect about 24–46 miles, 7 groups: A, B, C, and Development D-1 through D-4.

About the SDBC Saturday Ride group ride

Seven groups roll every Saturday from UC Cyclery, rain or shine, fastest first. First-timers fill out a form, come to the 8:15 orientation and start with a Development group. The D-4 ride is 24 miles and allows pedal-assist e-bikes. Open to the public.
